(vertigo) Paroymsal Positional Vertigo.standard_dosage: 25 mg orally 1-3 times daily as needed
(vertigo) Paroymsal Positional Vertigo.key_cautions: May cause drowsiness; avoid driving. Not for long-term use.

(vertigo) Paroymsal Positional Vertigo.standard_dosage: 8-16 mg three times daily with meals
(vertigo) Paroymsal Positional Vertigo.key_cautions: Use with caution in peptic ulcer disease and asthma.

AIDS.standard_dosage: One tablet once daily, with or without food
AIDS.key_cautions: Regular monitoring of kidney function and viral load required. Never stop without medical advice.
Monitor for allergic skin reactions. Maintain adequate hydration.

Acne.standard_dosage: Apply 2.5-5% gel to affected areas once or twice daily after washing face
Acne.key_cautions: May cause skin dryness and peeling. Use sunscreen as it increases sun sensitivity.

Acne.standard_dosage: Apply 0.1% gel to clean, dry skin once daily at bedtime
Acne.key_cautions: Avoid sun exposure. May worsen acne initially for 2-4 weeks before improvement.

Acne.standard_dosage: Apply 1% solution/gel to affected areas twice daily
Acne.key_cautions: Use with benzoyl peroxide to prevent antibiotic resistance. Avoid contact with eyes.

Alcoholic hepatitis.standard_dosage: 40 mg once daily for 28 days, then taper (physician supervised)
Alcoholic hepatitis.key_cautions: Only for severe alcoholic hepatitis (Maddrey score ≥32). Monitor for infections.
Alcoholic hepatitis.contraindications: Active GI bleeding, uncontrolled infection, hepatorenal syndrome.

Alcoholic hepatitis.standard_dosage: 400 mg three times daily with meals for 28 days
Alcoholic hepatitis.key_cautions: Used when corticosteroids are contraindicated. Monitor liver and kidney function.
Essential to prevent Wernicke encephalopathy in alcoholic patients.

Allergy.standard_dosage: 10 mg once daily, with or without food
Allergy.key_cautions: May cause mild drowsiness in some individuals. Reduce dose in renal impairment.

Allergy.standard_dosage: 10 mg once daily in the evening
Allergy.key_cautions: Monitor for neuropsychiatric effects (mood changes, sleep disturbances).

Allergy.standard_dosage: 2 sprays in each nostril once daily
Allergy.key_cautions: Takes 2-3 days for full effect. May cause nosebleeds with prolonged use.

Arthritis.standard_dosage: 50 mg orally twice or three times daily with food
Arthritis.key_cautions: Take with food to protect stomach. Avoid in kidney disease. Use lowest effective dose.
Arthritis.contraindications: Active GI bleeding, severe heart failure, late pregnancy.

Arthritis.standard_dosage: 7.5-25 mg once weekly (NOT daily) with folic acid supplement
Arthritis.key_cautions: Weekly dosing only. Regular blood tests for liver and blood counts required.
Arthritis.contraindications: Pregnancy, severe liver/kidney disease, active infection.

Bronchial Asthma.standard_dosage: 2 puffs (100 mcg each) inhaled via MDI as needed for acute symptoms. Max 8 puffs/day.
Bronchial Asthma.key_cautions: Use a spacer for better delivery. If using more than 2 times per week, asthma needs better controller therapy.

Bronchial Asthma.standard_dosage: 200-400 mcg inhaled twice daily via dry powder inhaler or nebulizer
Bronchial Asthma.key_cautions: Rinse mouth after each use to prevent oral thrush. Do not stop suddenly.

Bronchial Asthma.standard_dosage: 10 mg once daily in the evening
Bronchial Asthma.key_cautions: Add-on therapy; does not replace inhalers. Watch for mood/behavior changes.

Cervical spondylosis.standard_dosage: 400 mg orally three times daily with food as needed
Cervical spondylosis.key_cautions: Take with food. Avoid prolonged use without medical supervision.
Cervical spondylosis.contraindications: Active GI ulcers, severe kidney disease, aspirin-sensitive asthma.

Cervical spondylosis.standard_dosage: 75 mg twice daily, may increase to 150 mg twice daily
Cervical spondylosis.key_cautions: May cause dizziness, drowsiness. Do not stop abruptly — taper gradually.

Chicken pox.key_cautions: STRICTLY avoid Aspirin (risk of Reye syndrome, especially in children). Avoid ibuprofen (may worsen skin infection).

Chicken pox.standard_dosage: 800 mg orally 5 times daily for 5-7 days (adults). Start within 24 hours of rash onset.
Chicken pox.key_cautions: Most effective when started early. Drink plenty of water to protect kidneys.

Chicken pox.standard_dosage: Apply to itchy skin areas 2-3 times daily
Chicken pox.key_cautions: For external use only. Do not apply to broken or infected blisters.

Chronic cholestasis.standard_dosage: 13-15 mg/kg/day in 2-3 divided doses with meals
Chronic cholestasis.key_cautions: Long-term therapy may be required. Monitor liver function tests periodically.
Chronic cholestasis.contraindications: Complete biliary obstruction, acute liver inflammation.

Chronic cholestasis.standard_dosage: 4 g orally 1-2 times daily, mixed in water or juice
Chronic cholestasis.key_cautions: Take other medications 1 hour before or 4-6 hours after cholestyramine (blocks absorption). May cause constipation.

Common Cold.key_cautions: Do not exceed maximum daily dose. Avoid combining with other paracetamol-containing products.

Common Cold.standard_dosage: 4 mg every 4-6 hours as needed (Max: 24 mg/day)
Common Cold.key_cautions: Causes drowsiness — do not drive. Helps with runny nose and sneezing.
For dry cough only (not productive cough). Avoid in children under 6.

Dengue.key_cautions: ONLY safe fever reducer in dengue. STRICTLY AVOID Aspirin, Ibuprofen, and all NSAIDs — they increase bleeding risk.

Dengue.standard_dosage: Dissolve 1 sachet in 1 Litre clean water; sip frequently throughout the day
Dengue.key_cautions: Critical for preventing dehydration and dengue shock syndrome. Continue even if vomiting.

Dengue.standard_dosage: 1100 mg tablet twice daily for 5 days
Dengue.key_cautions: Supportive evidence for platelet count improvement. Use as adjunct, not replacement for medical care.

Diabetes.standard_dosage: 500 mg twice daily with meals, gradually increase to 1000 mg twice daily
Diabetes.key_cautions: Take with food to reduce GI side effects. Stay hydrated. Stop 48 hours before contrast dye procedures.

Diabetes.standard_dosage: 1-2 mg once daily with breakfast, may increase to 4 mg
Diabetes.key_cautions: Can cause low blood sugar (hypoglycemia). Always carry glucose tablets. Do not skip meals.
Diabetes.contraindications: Type 1 diabetes, diabetic ketoacidosis, severe liver disease.

Dimorphic hemmorhoids(piles).standard_dosage: Apply a small amount to the anal area twice daily (morning and night) for 2-4 weeks
Dimorphic hemmorhoids(piles).key_cautions: For external use only. Wash hands before and after application.

Dimorphic hemmorhoids(piles).standard_dosage: 500 mg (Diosmin 450mg + Hesperidin 50mg) twice daily with meals
Dimorphic hemmorhoids(piles).key_cautions: Most effective when combined with high-fiber diet and adequate water intake.

Dimorphic hemmorhoids(piles).standard_dosage: 1-2 teaspoons in a glass of water before bedtime
Dimorphic hemmorhoids(piles).key_cautions: Drink plenty of water. Helps soften stool and reduce straining.

Drug Reaction.key_cautions: For mild allergic drug reactions (rash, itching). Stop the offending drug immediately.
For moderate-severe drug reactions. Short course only under medical supervision.
Drug Reaction.contraindications: Active systemic fungal infections, untreated bacterial infections.

Fungal infection.standard_dosage: Apply 1% cream to affected area twice daily for 2-4 weeks
Fungal infection.key_cautions: Continue for at least 1 week after symptoms clear to prevent recurrence. Keep area dry.

Fungal infection.standard_dosage: Topical: Apply 1% cream once daily for 1-2 weeks. Oral: 250 mg daily for 2-6 weeks.
Fungal infection.key_cautions: Oral form requires liver function monitoring. More effective than azoles for dermatophytes.
Fungal infection.contraindications: Chronic or active liver disease (oral form).

GERD.standard_dosage: 20 mg once daily, 30-60 minutes before breakfast, for 4-8 weeks
GERD.key_cautions: Long-term use requires monitoring of magnesium, vitamin B12, and bone density.

GERD.standard_dosage: 10 mg three times daily, 15-30 minutes before meals
GERD.key_cautions: Helps with nausea and improves stomach emptying. Avoid in patients with cardiac arrhythmias.

GERD.standard_dosage: 10-15 mL suspension after meals and at bedtime as needed
GERD.key_cautions: Provides quick relief. Space 2 hours from other medications.

Gastroenteritis.standard_dosage: Dissolve 1 sachet in 1 Litre clean water; sip frequently
Gastroenteritis.key_cautions: Most important treatment — prevents dehydration. Continue even during vomiting (small sips).

Gastroenteritis.standard_dosage: 4-8 mg orally or sublingually every 8 hours as needed
Gastroenteritis.key_cautions: Controls nausea and vomiting effectively. May cause headache or constipation.

Gastroenteritis.standard_dosage: 20 mg daily for 10-14 days (children: 10 mg/day if under 6 months)
Gastroenteritis.key_cautions: Reduces duration and severity of diarrhea. Take with food to avoid nausea.

Heart attack.standard_dosage: 325 mg CHEWED immediately at first sign of heart attack (if not allergic)
Heart attack.key_cautions: CHEW, do not swallow whole — works faster. Do NOT take if allergic to aspirin or actively bleeding.

Heart attack.standard_dosage: 0.4 mg sublingual (under tongue), may repeat every 5 min up to 3 doses
Heart attack.key_cautions: Sit or lie down before taking (can cause dizziness/low BP). Do not use with erectile dysfunction drugs.
Heart attack.contraindications: Severe hypotension, use of PDE5 inhibitors.

Hepatitis A.standard_dosage: 500 mg every 6 hours as needed for fever (Max: 2g/day in liver disease)
Hepatitis A.key_cautions: Use LOWER doses due to liver involvement. Avoid alcohol completely.

Hepatitis A.standard_dosage: Dissolve 1 sachet in 1 Litre clean water; sip frequently
Hepatitis A.key_cautions: Essential for maintaining hydration during nausea and poor appetite.

Hepatitis B.standard_dosage: 300 mg once daily, with or without food
Hepatitis B.key_cautions: Long-term therapy required. Monitor kidney function and bone density regularly.

Hepatitis B.standard_dosage: 0.5 mg once daily on empty stomach (1 mg if lamivudine-resistant)
Hepatitis B.key_cautions: Take on empty stomach (2 hours before or after meals). Do not stop abruptly.

Hepatitis C.standard_dosage: One tablet (400mg/100mg) once daily for 12 weeks
Hepatitis C.key_cautions: Cures >95% of all HCV genotypes. Complete full 12-week course. Avoid with certain heart medications.
Hepatitis C.contraindications: Use with rifampin, carbamazepine, St. John's wort.

Hepatitis C.standard_dosage: 800-1200 mg/day in 2 divided doses with food (weight-based)
Hepatitis C.key_cautions: Used in combination with DAAs for difficult cases. Can cause anemia; monitor blood counts.
Hepatitis C.contraindications: Pregnancy (Category X), severe cardiac disease, hemoglobinopathies.

Hepatitis D.standard_dosage: 180 mcg subcutaneous injection once weekly for 48 weeks
Hepatitis D.key_cautions: Can cause flu-like symptoms, fatigue, and depression. Regular blood monitoring required.
Hepatitis D.contraindications: Decompensated cirrhosis, autoimmune hepatitis, severe depression.

Hepatitis D.key_cautions: New targeted therapy for chronic HDV. Monitor bile acid levels.

Hepatitis E.standard_dosage: 500 mg every 6 hours as needed (Max: 2g/day due to liver involvement)
Hepatitis E.key_cautions: Use reduced doses. Avoid alcohol. Supportive care is the mainstay of treatment.

Hepatitis E.standard_dosage: Dissolve 1 sachet in 1 Litre water; sip frequently throughout the day
Hepatitis E.key_cautions: Maintains hydration during nausea and poor appetite phase.

Hypertension.standard_dosage: 5 mg once daily, may increase to 10 mg once daily
Hypertension.key_cautions: May cause ankle swelling and flushing. Do not stop suddenly. Take at the same time each day.
Protects kidneys in diabetic patients. Monitor potassium and kidney function.

Hypertension.standard_dosage: 12.5-25 mg once daily in the morning
Hypertension.key_cautions: Monitor electrolytes (potassium, sodium). May increase blood sugar slightly. Stay hydrated.
Hypertension.contraindications: Anuria, severe renal failure, sulfonamide allergy.

Hyperthyroidism.standard_dosage: 10-30 mg daily initially, reduce to 5-10 mg maintenance
Hyperthyroidism.key_cautions: Regular thyroid function and blood count monitoring. Report sore throat or fever immediately (risk of agranulocytosis).
Hyperthyroidism.contraindications: Severe liver disease, prior agranulocytosis from thionamides.

Hyperthyroidism.key_cautions: Controls rapid heartbeat, tremor, and anxiety while antithyroid drugs take effect. Do not stop abruptly.
Hyperthyroidism.contraindications: Severe asthma, heart block, decompensated heart failure.

Hypoglycemia.standard_dosage: 15-20g glucose (3-4 tablets) at first sign of low blood sugar. Recheck after 15 min.
Hypoglycemia.key_cautions: Always carry glucose tablets if on insulin or sulfonylureas. Follow with a balanced snack.

Hypoglycemia.standard_dosage: 1 mg intramuscular or 3 mg intranasal for severe hypoglycemia when patient cannot swallow
Hypoglycemia.key_cautions: For emergency use when patient is unconscious. Train family members to administer.

Hypothyroidism.standard_dosage: 25-100 mcg once daily on empty stomach, 30-60 minutes before breakfast
Hypothyroidism.key_cautions: Take on empty stomach with water only. Do not take with calcium, iron, or antacids (space 4 hours). Dose adjusted based on TSH.
May help reduce thyroid antibodies in Hashimoto's thyroiditis. Do not exceed 400 mcg/day.

Impetigo.standard_dosage: Apply 2% ointment to affected areas three times daily for 5-10 days
Impetigo.key_cautions: For localized impetigo. Clean and gently remove crusts before applying. Wash hands after use.

Impetigo.standard_dosage: 250-500 mg orally four times daily for 7 days
Impetigo.key_cautions: For widespread impetigo or when topical treatment fails. Complete the full course.
Impetigo.contraindications: Cephalosporin allergy (use with caution if penicillin allergic).

Jaundice.standard_dosage: 300 mg twice or three times daily with meals
Jaundice.key_cautions: Helps improve bile flow. Treatment depends on the underlying cause of jaundice.
Jaundice.contraindications: Complete biliary obstruction, acute liver inflammation.

Jaundice.standard_dosage: 140 mg three times daily with meals
Jaundice.key_cautions: Supportive therapy for liver protection. Well-tolerated with few side effects.
Jaundice.contraindications: Allergy to plants in the daisy family.

Malaria.standard_dosage: Initial 600 mg base, then 300 mg at 6h, 24h, and 48h (physician supervised)
Malaria.key_cautions: For P. vivax and chloroquine-sensitive P. falciparum. Requires G6PD screening.
Malaria.contraindications: Retinopathy, known hypersensitivity, resistant Plasmodium strains.

Malaria.standard_dosage: 4 tablets (80/480mg) twice daily for 3 days with fatty food
Malaria.key_cautions: First-line for P. falciparum malaria. Take with food/milk for better absorption.
Malaria.contraindications: First trimester pregnancy, severe hepatic impairment.

Malaria.standard_dosage: 650 mg every 6 hours as needed for fever
Malaria.key_cautions: For symptomatic relief of fever and body aches. Do not exceed 3g daily.

Migraine.standard_dosage: 50-100 mg orally at onset of migraine. May repeat after 2 hours. Max: 200 mg/day.
Migraine.key_cautions: Take at first sign of headache (not during aura). Do not use more than 10 days/month to avoid medication overuse headache.
Migraine.contraindications: Uncontrolled hypertension, coronary artery disease, history of stroke.

Migraine.standard_dosage: 500-550 mg at onset, may take 250 mg after 6-8 hours
Migraine.key_cautions: Take with food. Effective for mild-moderate migraines. Can combine with triptans for severe attacks.

Migraine.standard_dosage: 40-80 mg twice daily for prevention (not for acute attacks)
Migraine.key_cautions: For patients with 4+ migraines/month. Takes 4-6 weeks for full preventive effect.

Osteoarthritis.key_cautions: First-line pain relief for mild-moderate OA. Safer than NSAIDs for long-term use.

Osteoarthritis.standard_dosage: Apply 1% gel to affected joint 3-4 times daily. Rub in gently.
Osteoarthritis.key_cautions: Effective for knee and hand OA. Fewer stomach side effects than oral NSAIDs.

Osteoarthritis.standard_dosage: Glucosamine 1500 mg + Chondroitin 1200 mg daily (in divided doses)
Osteoarthritis.key_cautions: May take 8-12 weeks to show benefit. Supportive evidence mixed but well-tolerated.

Paralysis (brain hemorrhage).key_cautions: Reduces brain swelling in hemorrhagic stroke. Hospital emergency use only.
Paralysis (brain hemorrhage).contraindications: Severe dehydration, anuria, active intracranial bleeding.

Paralysis (brain hemorrhage).standard_dosage: 10-20 mg IV bolus, then infusion to target BP (hospital supervised)
Paralysis (brain hemorrhage).key_cautions: Used to carefully lower dangerously high blood pressure in hemorrhagic stroke.
Paralysis (brain hemorrhage).contraindications: Severe asthma, heart block, cardiogenic shock.

Peptic ulcer disease.standard_dosage: 40 mg once daily before breakfast for 4-8 weeks
Peptic ulcer disease.key_cautions: Suppresses acid production to allow ulcer healing. Take before meals.

Peptic ulcer disease.standard_dosage: Amoxicillin 1g + Clarithromycin 500mg, both twice daily for 14 days (with PPI)
Peptic ulcer disease.key_cautions: For H. pylori positive ulcers. Complete full 14-day course even if feeling better.
Peptic ulcer disease.contraindications: Penicillin allergy (for amoxicillin), macrolide allergy (for clarithromycin).

Peptic ulcer disease.standard_dosage: 1 g four times daily, 1 hour before meals and at bedtime
Peptic ulcer disease.key_cautions: Creates a protective barrier over the ulcer. Take on empty stomach.

Pneumonia.standard_dosage: 500 mg-1g orally three times daily for 5-7 days
Pneumonia.key_cautions: First-line for community-acquired pneumonia. Complete full antibiotic course.

Pneumonia.standard_dosage: 500 mg on Day 1, then 250 mg daily for Days 2-5
Pneumonia.key_cautions: Good alternative for penicillin-allergic patients. Take on empty stomach for best absorption.

Pneumonia.standard_dosage: 650 mg every 6 hours for fever and body pain
Pneumonia.key_cautions: For symptomatic relief. Do not exceed 3g daily.

Psoriasis.standard_dosage: Apply thin layer to affected areas twice daily for up to 2 weeks
Psoriasis.key_cautions: For thick plaques only. Do not use on face/groin. Do not use for more than 2 weeks continuously.

Psoriasis.standard_dosage: Apply to affected areas twice daily (Max: 100g/week)
Psoriasis.key_cautions: Often combined with topical steroids for better results. Avoid excessive sun exposure on treated areas.

Psoriasis.standard_dosage: 7.5-25 mg ONCE WEEKLY (NOT daily) with folic acid supplement
Psoriasis.key_cautions: For moderate-severe psoriasis. WEEKLY dosing only. Regular blood tests required.

Tuberculosis.standard_dosage: Based on weight: 4 tablets daily for 2 months (intensive phase), then Isoniazid + Rifampicin for 4 months (continuation)
Tuberculosis.key_cautions: NEVER stop treatment early even if feeling better. Take on empty stomach. Urine may turn red-orange (normal).
Prevents isoniazid-induced peripheral neuropathy (tingling/numbness in hands/feet).

Typhoid.key_cautions: Effective against multi-drug resistant Salmonella typhi. Complete full course.
Alternative first-line for uncomplicated typhoid. Take with or without food.

Typhoid.standard_dosage: Dissolve 1 sachet in 1 Litre clean water; sip frequently
Typhoid.key_cautions: Essential for hydration during fever and diarrhea.

Urinary tract infection.standard_dosage: 100 mg twice daily for 5 days (take with food)
Urinary tract infection.key_cautions: Take with food for better absorption and less nausea. Complete full course.
Urinary tract infection.contraindications: Severe kidney disease (CrCl <30), G6PD deficiency, first trimester pregnancy.

Urinary tract infection.standard_dosage: 500 mg twice daily for 3 days (uncomplicated UTI)
Urinary tract infection.key_cautions: Reserved for resistant UTIs. May cause tendon problems — stop if pain occurs. Stay well hydrated.
Urinary tract infection.contraindications: Tendon disorders, myasthenia gravis, children under 18.

Urinary tract infection.standard_dosage: 500 mg twice daily for prevention of recurrent UTIs
Urinary tract infection.key_cautions: Supportive/preventive only — not a replacement for antibiotics in active infection.

Varicose veins.standard_dosage: 500 mg twice daily with meals for at least 2-3 months
Varicose veins.key_cautions: Improves venous tone and reduces leg heaviness. Combine with compression stockings.

Varicose veins.standard_dosage: 300 mg two to three times daily
Varicose veins.key_cautions: Reduces capillary permeability and edema. Apply topical gel for localized relief.
